Guidance: A brief description of the requirement or need. The description should be no more than one or two sentences.
A way of prioritizing or ranking the requirements. This can be in summary groups, such as high, medium and low, or it can be numbered 1, 2, 3.
This field can either be a user story that is prioritized, or it can indicate the name of a user story that is recorded elsewhere.
Indicates if the requirement is not started, in progress, or complete.
